method: Every assigned final rendered page was opened individually at original resolution in batches of five or fewer; Chinese text, superscripts/subscripts, labels/scores, display continuity, headings, diagrams, and QED inspected. Image SHA-256 values checked against final-render.json.

issues.finding: 两行P²=P推导跨页, 第二页页首只有等号开头的结论行. 内容完整, 无裁剪, 但短推导连续性受损.
issues.suggested_fix: 保持所有计算, 用equation*包aligned阻止此显示公式内分页.

issues.finding: 两行Christoffel变换题面跨页, 负二阶Jacobian项单独在次页页首. 内容完整, 但核心题式应整体呈现.
issues.suggested_fix: 保持题式与指标, 用equation*包aligned保持两行同页.

issues.finding: 三行逆度规导数推导跨页, 末行单独在次页页首. 内容完整, 但短推导连续性受损.
issues.suggested_fix: 保持所有计算, 用equation*包aligned保持三行同页.

validator_reminders.evidence: 显示尺寸积分在列表中完整可读, (a)(b)(c)标签清楚, 无相邻文字碰撞或边界溢出. 列表跨页时小问保持完整.
解答末尾显示公式后, 原生amsthm QED在下一行靠右, 清楚位于该解答与下一题之间, 无重复、剪裁或独占下一页.

boundaries: This report applies only to the exact bound PDF SHA-256 and its recorded rendered images.
Only PDF pages 54–81 were reviewed in this task; no claim about pages outside the assigned range.
This is visual review, not an independent proof that all mathematical content is correct.
No source files were changed. If root applies layout fixes and recompiles, all changed image hashes/pages require renewed visual inspection.
